inline_image: * Level 3: goals $300K-$1M = goal + $300K; goals over $1M = 120% of goal

files.name: repo/docs/goal-targets.md
files.text:
# Goal targets

Level targets for the dealer program.

```text
level 1 = ROUND(goal * 0.90, 0)
level 2 = ROUND(goal, 0)
level 3 = ROUND(goal + 300000, 0)
          when 300000 <= goal <= 1000000
        = ROUND(goal * 1.20, 0)
          otherwise
```

reference: hey Morgan -- yep, that's already built in. any goal from $300k to $1m gets level 3 at goal + $300k, and over $1m gets 120%. ex. prairie pump co is at $300k with level 3 at $600k. the one thing it doesn't do is force the $300k minimum. 7 dealers came in under it: red mesa water ($75k), dry creek pivots ($120k), sandhill supply and granite ag services ($125k), lone oak pumps ($175k), willow bend farm supply ($220k) and elm ridge water ($275k). want me to bump those up to $300k? then their level 3 would land at $600k.

title: Notice deadline from a PDF contract
subject: RE: Telematics renewal

files.name: Telematics Services Agreement.pdf
lines: Section 4. Term. The initial term ends on March 31, 2027.
Section 5. Renewal. The term renews automatically for 12 months unless either party gives
at least 60 days prior written notice of non-renewal.
Section 6. Fees. Annual fee: $48,000, payable in advance.

thread.body: Jordan, if we don't want this to auto-renew, what's the last day we can give notice? Contract attached.

reference: hey Sydney -- the term ends march 31, 2027 and we need 60 days' written notice, so the last day is january 30, 2027. if we're not renewing, I'd send it a week or two before that.

title: Does the spec cover two features (one yes, one no)
subject: RE: Dealer portal spec v2

files.name: Dealer Portal Spec v2.docx
paras: 1. Scope: order status, invoices and warranty claims.
2. Login: single sign-on (SSO) through the company identity provider, with MFA.
3. Reports: order history viewable on screen and printable to PDF.
4. Out of scope: bulk exports, price edits.

thread.body: Hi Jordan, quick one: does v2 cover SSO and export to Excel? Need to tell the dealer council.

reference: hey Riley -- SSO yes: section 2 has single sign-on through our identity provider with MFA. excel export no: reports are on screen and print to PDF, and bulk exports are listed as out of scope. if the council needs excel, I can scope it as an add-on.

title: Asks if logic is missing a cap that the code has
subject: RE: Discount logic

files.name: repo/src/discounts.py

thread.body: Jordan, is the Level 2 discount logic missing the cap? A dealer said they got 20% off.

reference: hey Jamie -- no, the cap is there: level 2 discounts are capped at 15% of list in the code. a 20% discount wouldn't come from that path, so it's likely a manual override or a different promo. send me the order # and I'll trace it.
